title: UMG Output Blueprint Resolution Schema
description: Schema for the OutputBlueprintResolver subsystem. Handles Blueprint-level conflicts when multiple horizontal lanes produce competing output format preferences. Produces a resolved output blueprint — either a single winning lane's Blueprint or a declared OutputComposite. Part of the resolveOutputBlueprint() pass.

resolution_id.description: Unique identifier for this resolution. Convention: OBR-{runtime_id}.

active_lanes.description: Horizontal lane IDs that were active at time of resolution.

competing_blueprints.description: Blueprint preferences submitted by each active lane.

lane_weight.description: The lane's weight at time of blueprint submission. Higher weight = stronger preference.

conflict_with.description: Lane IDs whose Blueprint preferences conflict with this one.

blueprint_conflict_detected.description: True if two or more active lanes produced conflicting Blueprint preferences.

conflict_type.description: Classification of the Blueprint conflict type. Null if no conflict.

resolved_output.description: The resolved output format for this response.

output_type.description: Blueprint block name (e.g. Markdown) or OutputComposite type_id (e.g. StructuredIdeationMap).

is_composite.description: True if resolved to a declared OutputComposite type.

composite_type_id.description: The OutputComposite type_id from the declared registry. Null if not composite.

resolution_method.description: How the resolver reached this output type.

blueprint_behavior.description: Concrete description of the output format this response should follow.

winning_lane.description: The lane whose Blueprint preference governs. Null if composite resolution.

contributing_lanes.description: All lanes whose preferences contributed to a composite resolution.

suppressed_blueprints.description: Blueprint preferences that were suppressed in favor of the resolved output.

conflict_trace.description: Step-by-step trace of the conflict detection and resolution process.

resolutionPriority.description: Order of resolution methods attempted by the OutputBlueprintResolver.

steps.condition: Only one lane is active or only one lane has a Blueprint preference.
Active lanes have Blueprint preferences that can combine without contradiction (e.g. Markdown + structured sections).
Active lanes match the valid_when conditions of a declared OutputComposite in the registry.
No composite available. The lane carrying the highest-authority MOLT block wins.
No hierarchy distinction. The lane with the highest weight at resolution time wins.
Tie-break: suppress the lower-priority lane's Blueprint preference.

resolved_output.blueprint_behavior: Structured sections defined by analytical decomposition, with open generative content within each section.
Standard Markdown output. Code blocks, headers, and lists where appropriate.
